answers.label: Straight to the agent, one press
answers.note: hybrid: send button in the brief —- keeps user focused in the brief (no toggling back to chat)
answers.question: Inside Flight Deck at work, how do your answers reach the agent?

layout.label: One page, briefing beside your call
layout.note: We may later add the narrations — they’re useful but not a core feature set
layout.question: How should a brief lay out each decision?

record.label: Something else
record.note: Should be exclusively within the project; briefs are just a decision artifact, so put them in the project decisions folder
record.question: Where should a decision be written down once you lock it?

trigger.label: Something else
trigger.note: Agents will need to use judgment, but generally when the decision requires context, is more than one question, and/or has a visual component to the decision that isn’t well suited to chat
trigger.question: When should an agent make a brief instead of asking with a card?
